scope: Publish-versus-draft consequences, month-specific existing confirmation, publish form lifecycle and checklist read recovery.
changes: Add selected-month consequence copy distinguishing application of a draft from final publication; existing server prerequisites and approval gates unchanged.

Native confirmation identifies selected month. Existing endpoint, warning acknowledgement and trimmed approval-note payload retained. Required note now receives aria-required, inline description, invalid state/focus on empty submit and error clearing on input.

Guard duplicate submissions per existing form with WeakSet and aria-busy. Capture submitted month/account/form; late results cannot commit to another month/view/account. No server request cancellation or rollback claimed.

Separate confirmed publication from failed followup read. Confirmed-success read failure shows Publication recorded and GET-only Retry checklist, without another publication form. Initialread failure also offers GET-only retry.

Retry restores owned focus to current retry/export/note only if newer focus was not chosen. Existing tracker reads remain supported; test read counts include them rather than assuming exactly one initialGET.

scenarios: 503 publication refusal retains note/warning and reenables action
confirmed publication then failed checklist read and GET-only retry
initial checklist failure and GET-only retry
checks.confirmation: Missing note sends noPOST; dismissing month-specific confirmation preserves note and sends noPOST; synthetic duplicate submit while pending causes no second confirmation/POST.
checks.server_contract: All publish writes intercepted; exact November2026 endpoint/month, confirm_warnings:true and approval_note unchanged. Failed followup read retries onlyGET; no automatic publication replay.
checks.static_inventories: Style/action source write/check match; static integrity only.

limitations: Root implementer verification, not independent signoff.
42contexts use defaultlight; other theme/role/permission combinations and every server prerequisite reason remain unverified beyond declared fixtures.
Duplicate guard includes synthetic submit testing; this is a frontend concurrency protection, not backend idempotency certification.
Late route/month paths tested; account-switch guard is source protection, not a newly exercised multi-account race audit.
No actual publishing/backend/production writes. Server refusal and confirmed-success responses are intercepted fixtures; no backend confirmation/persistence/permissions/export equivalence certified.
Four scoped axe checks do not prove all AT behavior; native screen readers, physical devices and full260 acceptance remain open.
Only frontend main.ts and generation action test confirmation expectation changed in this batch. No backend/API/scheduling/persistedsemantics/exportcontent changes; concurrent work preserved.
